sections.name: File setup, OfficialRecordContextVariant
sections.title: Imports and display variant type
sections.what: Brings in the link, state and effect tools, the translation helpers, the detail block, and the record type. Defines the two display variants.
sections.why: Lets one component show the same records in two different layouts.
sections.watch_out: The variant names must match what the calling pages pass in.

sections.name: importedRecordDocumentSummary
sections.title: Summary of a record for display
sections.what: Turns one imported record into the short set of values shown on screen, such as khata, khesra, the area with two decimal places and the unit, the source name, provenance and identity match.
sections.why: Keeps the display code simple by preparing the values in one place.
sections.watch_out: The area is formatted to two decimal places, so very small differences will not show.

sections.name: DocumentImportedRecords (part 1)
sections.title: Documents list header and status
sections.what: Shows the section heading and then either a loading note, an error alert, or an empty message with a link to the official records lookup page.
sections.why: Tells the user what is happening while records load or when none are linked yet.
sections.watch_out: The error message appears only for the documents variant, so the other variant will show an empty state instead.

sections.name: DocumentImportedRecords (part 2)
sections.title: Imported record cards
sections.what: For each record, shows a synthetic label, the record name, a note that it is not authoritative, the khata, khesra, area and identity match. Provides a details block with the provider, provenance and source, and a button to view the record.
sections.why: Gives each record a clear, cautious presentation and the details needed to check where it came from.
sections.watch_out: The labels Khata and Khesra are English only, so a Hindi user will see mixed languages.

sections.name: OfficialRecordContext (part 1)
sections.title: Fetch on load
sections.what: When the component appears or the case changes, requests the imported records for that case. Stores the result, or marks the request as failed. It ignores results that arrive after the component has left the screen.
sections.why: Loads the records when needed and avoids updating a screen that is no longer shown.
sections.watch_out: The case ID is placed directly in the address, so an unusual ID could break the request.

sections.name: OfficialRecordContext: if
sections.title: Choosing the layout
sections.what: On the documents variant, passes the records and the load state to the list view. Otherwise, shows nothing while loading, or a summary card with the first record's khata, khesra and area, or an empty message with a link.
sections.why: Lets one component serve two places with different amounts of space.
sections.watch_out: Only the first record is shown in the summary card, so any other records are hidden there.

summary: Shows the imported synthetic official-style records, either as a full list on the documents page or as a short summary card elsewhere.
purpose: Lets the owner see which official-style records have been linked to the case, clearly marked as not authoritative.
why: Likely reason: the records are synthetic and marked as not authoritative, so the owner is not misled. Reason partly stated in the text keys.
how: The main component fetches imported records for the case when it loads. On the documents variant, it passes the records to a list component that shows a loading, error, empty, or card view. On other variants, it shows a short card with the first record or an empty message. Each card shows the source, the fields and a link to the official records page.
inputs: A case ID, the imported records from the API, and the current language.
outputs: A list of record cards or a short summary card, with links to the official records page.
risks: Some labels such as Khata and Khesra are written in English only. A failed fetch shows an error message in the documents variant but an empty state elsewhere.
debug: If records do not appear, check the import endpoint response and the case ID. If labels are in the wrong language, check the translation helper. If the page shows nothing, check whether the fetch failed.
